correctness.rationale: Character orthogonality gives the fourth-moment factor 9/625 and the fourth-power source norm factor 1/25. Triangle inequality in the pair-sum fibers reduces maximization to nonnegative weights. At fixed squared mass on one axis pair the unfixed term is strictly increasing with the antipodal product, so each nonempty pair must balance. At fixed central-to-total-outer ratio, the reduced mixing derivative 24u(1−τ/sqrt(1+2u)) permits no interior maximum. The single-line endpoint has energy ratio at most 3 by Parseval on a group of order three; the equal-axis endpoint has unique maximum at t*=(sqrt(33)−1)/4, giving K=(729+33sqrt(33))/296, strictly above 3 and the flat value 77/25. Since every extremizing amplitude is positive, equality in the triangle step forces the phases at ±eᵢ, after dividing by the central phase, to be conjugate cube roots of unity. These two free exponents give exactly the character restrictions and align every fiber, with the zero function separate. Independent replay `python3 /workspace/branches/independent-replay.py 5` regenerated the nine fibers from ordered sums and checked the amplitude polynomial, sharp radical, flat case, derivative and nine character modulations symbolically.
residual_risks: Only the stated five-point cone with stated counting measures is established; the proof does not classify larger fields or higher-dimensional cones.

evidence: Koh–Shen excludes linear factors. The zero-radius sphere bounds are uniform in the field size, whereas the examined sharp cone theorems concern punctured four-dimensional cones. Resultary 65d29718d8f1 uses coordinate crosses but optimizes ||f̂||∞/||f̂||₄.
broader_coverage.reasoning: An extension bound uniform in the field size, an extremizer result on a punctured cone in a different dimension, or a different Fourier functional on the same cross does not yield this exact fixed-field inequality and classification. The direct equivalent catalogue match is decisive instead.

evidence: The equality family in the matching entry is the same positive central/outer amplitude profile modulated by one of nine characters and an arbitrary nonzero complex scalar.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Multiplying an inequality by the positive normalization factor leaves equality unchanged, so the prior exact energy theorem immediately gives the entire claimed extension result and rigidity. The inspected higher-dimensional sharp bounds do not do so.

But as a contribution this narrow exact invariant is already supplied with the same maximizers and sharp value. The frozen extension normalization does not create an independently useful new exact fact, theorem or application beyond that result.
